description: An Angular standalone component for confirming deletion of a note, displaying a modal dialog with 'Cancel' and 'Delete' options.

classes.name: ConfirmDeleteComponent
classes.description: A component providing a modal dialog to confirm deletion of a note, with input property 'note' and output events for cancel and confirm actions.

methods.name: onEscape
methods.description: Handles the Escape key press to trigger cancellation.

methods.name: onCancel
methods.description: Emits the cancel event to notify parent component.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Emits the confirm event to notify parent component that deletion is confirmed.
